bio.text: Brett Guthrie represents Kentucky's 2nd Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives, where he was first elected in 2008, and chairs the House Committee on Energy and Commerce in the 119th Congress.
He represented the 32nd District in the Kentucky Senate after being first elected to public office in 1998.
He graduated from the U.S. Military Academy at West Point in 1987, served as a Field Artillery Officer in the 101st Airborne Division, and earned a master's degree from Yale University.
He later joined Trace Die Cast, a Bowling Green, Kentucky, manufacturing business started by his father.
